ns2:course.label: Nonlinear Dynamics
ns2:course.description: (PHYCS 420) Broad introduction to nonlinear dynamics of physical systems with varying degrees of complexity; surveys a variety of concepts associated with bifurcation phenomena, mappings, nonlinear oscillations, chaotic behavior, strange attractors, solitons, and topics of current interest. Prerequisite: MATH 380 or MATH 385 or equivalent; PHYS 326 or equivalent; or consent of instructor.
